decisions.decision: All 80 profiles are untreated control iPSCs, two samples from each of forty lines. The project title refers to combination discovery goals rather than observed joint drug-expression treatments.

44 records mix ChIP and RNA assays. Three-repeat IRF2BP2 knockdown/dexamethasone/TNF comparisons across A549 and HEK293-GR include a higher-order regimen and differing cell states; assay count does not establish six complete fixed-state pair panels.

23 profiles from activated CD4 T cells of three donors under metformin/2-deoxyglucose conditions. Donor and within-donor sample labels cannot provide six independently initiated same-state culture panels, and the nominal pair graph has one pair.
